review_candidates.title: SWIFT Administrator
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Role: SWIFT Administrator (U3) Location: Cairo, Egypt Employment Type: Full Time Permanent Role Overview We are looking for an experienced SWIFT Administrator (U3) to manage and support SWIFT infrastructure and financial messaging platforms, ensuring system availability, security, compliance, and operational efficiency within a banking environment. Key Responsibilities Administer and maintain SWIFT Alliance Access (SAA), SWIFT Alliance Gateway (SAG), and SWIFTNet services. Troubleshoot incidents
eligibility_evidence: K&K Talents is an international recruiting agency that has been providing technical resources in the European region since 1993.
Note: Applicants for employment in Egypt should possess work authorization which does not require sponsorship by the employer for a visa.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: 4–7 years of experience in SWIFT administration, financial messaging, banking technology, or production support. Hands-on experience with SAA, SAG, SWIFTNet, RMA Management, and PKI/Certificate Management .
